### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Restrict content to patient-reported symptoms and history. Exclude all findings observed or elicited by the provider during the physical examination, as these belong in the Objective section.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Ensure all symptom modifiers (e.g., timing, triggers, location) are precisely attributed to the specific symptom they modify as stated by the patient. Do not combine modifiers from distinct patient statements to form new symptom descriptions.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Prevent cross-attribution of modifiers or descriptive elements between distinct symptoms or findings, even if both are patient-reported. Ensure each descriptive element (e.g., timing, triggers, location) is strictly tied to the specific symptom or finding it was stated to modify.
